scope: Offline fixtures and protocol simulation, NOT an actual BMW or donor SDK integration test

tests.name: Policy: allows only eight diagnostic Mode-01 PIDs
Policy: all non-read/non-flap services blocked, including ECU programming/reset/security/map writes
Policy: MHD map-switch 2F01, maxcool 2F03 and MG burble 2E6946 are blocked
Policy: flap allowed only in Pops with confirmation, fresh real parked speed, not DEMO
Policy: release an owned flap override permitted; cannot use release flag to open/close
TASU: exact byte framing and RPM 900 / speed zero decoding
TASU: exact MHD flap acknowledgement and separate readback
TASU: negative DME response retains NRC and raw command
TASU: protected service never reaches sendTasuRequest
TASU: readback failure is not reported as a confirmed physical flap position
TASU: stale speed at transmit is rejected even if it was fresh before connecting
TASU: truncated negative response is reported, not an uncaught exception
Telemetry: zero is a real reading, not a disconnected state
Telemetry: partial data never filled with simulated vehicle values
Telemetry: no data waits before DEMO; disabled DEMO shows OFFLINE
Telemetry: real signal returns immediately from DEMO
Telemetry: stale signals are unavailable and computed power uses only fresh real inputs
Telemetry: SOME/IP fixtures decode factor/offset and reject sentinel
Settings: backup marked NOT ECU; before-change backup restores previous value
Diagnostics: full error stack saved, credentials scrubbed
Views: all pages and 12 themes render; touch targets stay clear of native bars
Views: raster preview has transparent top 76 / bottom 120 design rows
Host: OnlineApp initialized -> state/resources -> entry mapping -> opened -> repeat tile tap
Host: missing entrypoint creates full start error rather than silently accepting
Bootstrap: SDK load failure is recorded to the app data directory before host construction
Renderer: compatibility HELLO/READY/FRAME, three apps, reopen and climate-safe claims
Touch: DOWN-only renderer taps switch pages; UP-only taps also work
Touch: sliders change local demo profiles via DOWN/MOVE/UP, never call ECU
Touch: E_TOUCH wire protocol parses phase and floating-point coordinates
Diagnostics HTTP: app discovery, full report, stale status, path/origin protection
Integration: actual renderer TOUCH packet activates a button after RHMI focus=false
